content.text: Sorry I am not ignoring your question, I just had to ponder it a bit. I believe there is sexism in the front office. I think (despite all my issues with Ellen) working for her has kind of sheltered me from direct sexism. Also, I had a skillset that was a valued and limited resource in the organization so I think that played a part as well.
I think I have mentioned it before as well, but I had heard enough rumors in the Ticket Sales Department to believe that there is a sexist environment but nothing that I can matter-of-fact speak on
I didn’t think you were. Thank you, I’ll give you a ring later
So for accounting purposes you’re a 1) Yes 2) No by default
But honestly I don’t think I can include non-ticket sales people in the ticket sales tally
Yeah
I feel like all these girls know that I’m trying to get ahold of them
Are you getting a lot of responses?
I’m getting a good response
I was kinda stressed yesterday. It’s a very uncomfortable thing to call people about, I’m sorry
I think It would be different if it was a female reporter. Like I’m not trying to get info on a baseball team
I’m trying to ask sensitive questions and I don’t even know these women.
It’s 2020! We’re 👏🏻having 👏🏻the 👏🏻 conversations!
And trying to make them feel comfortable enough to answer them to a reporter, though
Yeah that would be awkward
Are you working right now? I’m bored af if you wanna grab a drink or something
Yesterday I was thinking it would be a disaster. But I got responses and it felt good, like affirmation that I wasn’t being weird with my inquisition kinda thing
I just sat down to work on this
I mean, if you’re that bored you can roll through and I’ll show you this monster but
I also don’t want to be distracted lol but I’m in Allen Park
Haha thank you for the invite. I don’t want to distract you if you’re getting into it
Call me when you smoke your next cig, though, I’ll have one
Cig?
I just had one like 15 minutes ago when one of the women called me back, get me at your next one lol
Boooo haha prob my only one of the day. Have cut back a lootttt during quarantine
Bullshit
You’ll have one later
Okkkk fine. You are on last call. You down?
